players.product: silica glass (fabricated quartzware) for semiconductor applications and sputtering targets (Advanced Materials segment); water treatment engineering for semiconductor plants

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025): net sales JPY 499.1 billion, down JPY 28.5 billion (5.4%), as the stronger yen and lower naphtha prices cut selling prices and a larger scheduled turnaround at the Nanyo complex reduced volumes; operating income JPY 44.7 billion, down JPY 2.6 billion (5.6%); ordinary income JPY 45.7 billion (up 1.4%); net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 7.4 billion, down JPY 17.6 billion (70.4%), after a JPY 19.1 billion impairment loss on the fixed assets of US sputtering-target subsidiary Tosoh SMD. H1 R&D expenses about JPY 11.2 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 499.1 billion (-5.4%); operating income JPY 44.7 billion (-5.6%); impairment JPY 19.1 billion

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 segments: Functional Products net sales JPY 135.1 billion (down 1.0%) and operating income JPY 20.7 billion (down 3.9%) on worse inventory valuation and higher fixed costs - quartz glass shipments rose as LCD-application production, reduced a year earlier by an accident, recovered; sputtering target shipments rose overseas while selling prices fell on product mix. Engineering net sales JPY 85.8 billion (up 11.5%) and operating income JPY 18.5 billion (up 46.9%), as construction of semiconductor-related plant projects ordered in Japan and Taiwan in prior years progressed smoothly and solution projects were strong.
